archimate:ArchimateDiagramModel.name: Supporting Value Stream: Innovation and Methodological Development
archimate:ArchimateDiagramModel.documentation: Purpose and Description The Innovation and Methodological Development Value Stream drives continuous improvement and modernization across the statistical organization. Its objective is to identify, test, and implement new data sources, methodologies, and technologies that enhance statistical production, analytical capability, and efficiency. It ensures that innovation is not ad-hoc, but governed, traceable, and aligned with the organization’s strategic goals. This value stream turns research and experimentation into production-ready, validated methods and practices that can be embedded into core processes.
